definitions.gloss: local area; localized spot; specific part
definitions.explanation: A limited, specific area or part of a larger whole. Frequently used in medical and technical contexts to describe something affecting only a particular area rather than the whole.

examples.japanese: {局所|きょくしょ}⟦{麻酔|ますい}→麻酔：10581_masui⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: To perform surgery under local anesthesia.

examples.japanese: ⟦{局所的|きょくしょてき}→局所的：23813_kyokushoteki⟧な⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be cautious of localized heavy rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{炎症|えんしょう}→炎症：05978_enshou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{局所|きょくしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧とどまっており、⟦{全身|ぜんしん}→全身：03313_zenshin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていない→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: The inflammation is confined to a local area and has not spread throughout the body.

notes: Often used as a modifier with ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: ⟦{局所的|きょくしょてき}→局所的：23813_kyokushoteki⟧ (localized). Common collocations: {局所|きょくしょ}⟦{麻酔|ますい}→麻酔：10581_masui⟧ (local anesthesia), ⟦{局所的|きょくしょてき}→局所的：23813_kyokushoteki⟧な⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧ (localized heavy rain), {局所|きょくしょ}⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧ (local treatment). Contrasts with ⟦{全身|ぜんしん}→全身：03313_zenshin⟧ (whole body) and ⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧ (whole/overall). In weather forecasts, ⟦{局所的|きょくしょてき}→局所的：23813_kyokushoteki⟧な⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧ (commonly called ゲリラ⟦{豪雨|ごうう}→豪雨：05860_gouu⟧) is a frequently heard expression.
